data.desc: Bimergen Energy Corporation (NYSE American: BESS) is a U.S .-based energy infrastructure developer, asset owner, and operator focused on utility-scale and distributed battery energy storage systems (BESS). The Company develops projects designed to enhance grid reliability, support renewable energy integration, and provide flexible energy solutions across key U.S . power markets. Bimergen works with technology providers and capital partners to advance projects through development, construction, and long-term operation.
